translations.label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_LifeGoesSlowlyOnIsland
translations.original:
I left the major port of SLATEPORT
CITY when I married my husband here.

Life goes by slowly on this little
island. But being surrounded by the
beautiful sea--that's happiness, too.
translations.zh: 嫁给这里的丈夫时，我离开了大港口凯那市。在这个小岛上，日子过得很慢，不过被美丽的大海包围，也是一种幸福。

translations.label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_LotToBeSaidForLivingOnIsland
translations.original:
There's a lot to be said for living on
a small island like this in harmony with
POKéMON and the family.
translations.zh: 在这样的小岛上，与宝可梦和家人和谐相处，这样的生活很有滋味。

translations.label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool
translations.original:
Wow, you bothered to cross the sea
to visit DEWFORD?

Did you maybe come here because you
heard about BRAWLY?

He's so cool…
Everyone idolizes him.
translations.zh: 哇，你特意渡海来武斗镇？难道你也是听说藤树才来的？他太帅了……大家都崇拜他。

translations.label: DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaintedMonCanUseHM
translations.original:
Even if a POKéMON faints and can't
battle, it can still use a move learned
from a HIDDEN MACHINE (HM).
translations.zh: 宝可梦就算倒下、不能对战，还是可以使用通过秘传学习机学会的招式。

translations.label: DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_StoneCavern
translations.original:
There's a stone cavern at the edge
of town.

I've heard you can find rare stones
there.
translations.zh: 镇子边上有个石洞。据说在那里能找到稀有的石头。

translations.label: DewfordTown_Text_TinyIslandCommunity
translations.original:
DEWFORD is a tiny island community.
If something gets trendy here,
everyone picks up on it right away.
translations.zh: 武斗镇是个小小的岛屿社区。只要一样东西在这里流行起来，大家很快都会跟风。

translations.label: InsideOfTruck_Text_BoxPrintedWithMonLogo
translations.original:
The box is printed with a POKéMON logo.

It's a POKéMON brand moving and
delivery service.
translations.zh: 箱子上印着宝可梦的标志。这是宝可梦品牌的搬家与配送服务。

translations.label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSpendsDaysInLab
translations.original:
PROF. BIRCH spends days in his LAB
studying, then he'll suddenly go out in
the wild to do more research…

When does PROF. BIRCH spend time
at home?
translations.zh: 小田卷博士总是在研究所里埋头研究，有时又突然跑到野外调查。他到底什么时候才待在家里呢？

translations.label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems
translations.original:
If you use a PC, you can store items
and POKéMON.

The power of science is staggering!
translations.zh:
用PC就能把道具和宝可梦收放起来。
科学的力量真是伟大！

translations.label: OldaleTown_House1_Text_LeftPokemonGoesOutFirst
translations.original:
When a POKéMON battle starts, the one
at the left of the list goes out first.

So, when you get more POKéMON in your
party, try switching around the order
of your POKéMON.

It could give you an advantage.
translations.zh: 对战开始时，队伍名单最左边的宝可梦会先出场。伙伴多了以后，试着调整队伍的顺序吧，这可能让你占据优势。

translations.label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_PokemonLevelUp
translations.original:
When POKéMON battle, they eventually
level up and become stronger.
translations.zh: 宝可梦通过对战，逐渐提升等级，也会越来越强。

translations.label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_YoullGoFurtherWithStrongPokemon
translations.original:
If the POKéMON with you become
stronger, you'll be able to go farther
away from here.
translations.zh: 同行的宝可梦变强之后，你就能去更远的地方了。

translations.label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_RestoreHPWithPotion
translations.original:
If a POKéMON gets hurt and loses its HP
and faints, it won't be able to battle.

To prevent your POKéMON from fainting,
restore its HP with a POTION.
translations.zh: 宝可梦受伤、失去体力并倒下后，就不能继续对战了。在它倒下之前，用伤药恢复体力吧。

translations.label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonCentersAreGreat
translations.original:
POKéMON CENTERS are great!

You can use their services as much
as you like, and it's all for free.
You never have to worry!
translations.zh: 宝可梦中心真棒！服务可以随便使用，而且全都免费。完全不用担心！

translations.label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersCanUsePC
translations.original:
That PC in the corner there is
for any POKéMON TRAINER to use.

Naturally, that means you're welcome
to use it, too.
translations.zh: 角落里的电脑，所有宝可梦训练家都可以使用。当然，你也可以用。

translations.label: OldaleTown_Text_SavingMyProgress
translations.original:
I want to take a rest, so I'm saving my
progress.
translations.zh: 我想休息一下，所以先保存冒险记录。

translations.label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
translations.original:
Sigh…

I wish I could go on an adventure
with some POKéMON…

Crawl through some damp grass…
Climb rocky, rugged mountains…

Cross the raging seas…
Wander about in dark caves…

And, sometimes, even get a little
homesick…

It must be fabulous to travel!
translations.zh: 唉……真想和宝可梦一起冒险啊。穿过潮湿的草丛，爬上崎岖的山峰，渡过汹涌的大海，在黑暗的洞穴里漫游……偶尔也会有点想家。旅行一定很精彩！

translations.label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_TravelingIsWonderful
translations.original:
Traveling is wonderful!

When I was young, I roamed the seas
and the mountains!
translations.zh: 旅行真是美妙！年轻时，我走遍了大海和群山！

translations.label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
translations.original:
I battled NORMAN once, but, whew,
he was way too strong.

How would I put it?

I just got the feeling that he
lives for POKéMON.
translations.zh: 我和千里对战过一次，呼，他实在太强了。怎么说呢……总觉得他整个人都是为宝可梦而活的。

translations.label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGymLeader
translations.original:
NORMAN became our town's new
GYM LEADER.

I think he called his family over from
somewhere far away.
translations.zh: 千里是我们镇上新来的道馆馆主。他好像把住在很远地方的家人也接过来了。

translations.label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_RepelIsUseful
translations.original:
Do you use REPEL?
It keeps POKéMON away, so it's
useful when you're in a hurry.
translations.zh: 你用过除虫喷雾吗？它能让野生宝可梦避开你，赶路时很有用。

translations.label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidotesWithYou
translations.original:
Do you have any ANTIDOTES with
you?

If you walk around with a poisoned
POKéMON, it will lose HP until it faints.
Take some ANTIDOTES with you.
translations.zh: 带上解毒药了吗？带着中毒的宝可梦走路，它的体力会一直减少，直到倒下。准备些解毒药吧。

translations.label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStronger
translations.original:
Even if a POKéMON is weak now,
it will grow stronger.

The most important thing is love!
Love for your POKéMON!
translations.zh: 宝可梦现在就算很弱，以后也会变强。最重要的是爱！要爱你的宝可梦！

translations.label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OranBerryRegainedHP
translations.original:
When my POKéMON ate an
ORAN BERRY, it regained HP!
translations.zh: 我的宝可梦吃了橙橙果，体力就恢复了！

translations.label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCStorageSystem
translations.original:
That PC-based POKéMON Storage
System…

Whoever made it must be some kind
of a scientific wizard!
translations.zh: 电脑上的宝可梦存储系统……发明它的人一定是个科学奇才！

translations.label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
translations.original:
Hiya! Are you maybe…
A rookie TRAINER?

Do you know what POKéMON TRAINERS
do when they reach a new town?

They first check what kind of GYM
is in the town.
translations.zh: 你好！你是刚出发的训练家吗？知道训练家来到新城镇后，首先会做什么吗？他们会先看看这里是什么样的道馆。

translations.label: PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation
translations.original:
Let's say you have six POKéMON.
If you catch another one…

It is automatically sent to a STORAGE
BOX over a PC connection.
translations.zh: 假设队伍里已经有六只宝可梦，再捉到一只会怎么样？它会通过电脑连接，自动传送到存储盒里。

translations.label: PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally
translations.original:
Where has our WALLY gone?

We have to leave for VERDANTURF TOWN
very soon…
translations.zh: 我们家小光跑到哪里去了？我们很快就要出发去绿荫镇了……

translations.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanation
translations.original:
Sometimes, there are things on the
ground even if you can't see them.

That's why I always check where I'm
walking.
translations.zh: 有时候，地面上明明有东西，你却看不见。所以我走路时，总会仔细检查脚下。

translations.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass
translations.original:
Yo, there!
Your POKéMON doing okay?

If your POKéMON are weak and you want
to avoid battles, you should stay out
of tall grass.
translations.zh: 喂！你的宝可梦还好吗？如果它们很虚弱，想避开对战，就不要进入高高的草丛。

translations.label: Route101_Text_TakeTiredPokemonToPokeCenter
translations.original:
If POKéMON get tired, take them to
a POKéMON CENTER.

There's a POKéMON CENTER in OLDALE
TOWN right close by.
translations.zh: 宝可梦累了，就带它去宝可梦中心吧。附近的古辰镇就有一间。

translations.label: Route101_Text_WildPokemonInTallGrass
translations.original:
Wild POKéMON will jump out at you in
tall grass.

If you want to catch POKéMON, you have
to go into the tall grass and search.
translations.zh: 野生宝可梦会从高高的草丛里跳出来。想捕捉宝可梦，就得进草丛找找。

translations.label: Route102_Text_CatchWholeBunchOfPokemon
translations.original:
I'm going to catch a whole bunch of
POKéMON!
translations.zh: 我要捕捉好多好多宝可梦！

translations.label: Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall
translations.original:
I'm…not very tall, so I sink right
into tall grass.

The grass goes up my nose and…
Fwafwafwafwafwa…

Fwatchoo!
translations.zh: 我……个子不高，一进草丛就被淹没了。草都钻进鼻子里……啊、啊、啊……阿嚏！

translations.label: Route103_Text_ShortcutToOldale
translations.original:
If you cross the sea from here,
it'll be a shortcut to OLDALE TOWN.

Fufufu, that's useful, isn't it?
translations.zh: 从这里渡海，就能抄近路到古辰镇。呵呵，很方便吧？

translations.label: Route103_Text_ShouldHaveBroughtPotion
translations.original:
My POKéMON is staggeringly tired…
I should have brought a POTION…
translations.zh: 我的宝可梦累坏了……早知道该带上伤药……

translations.label: Route104_Text_BrineyLivesInSeasideCottage
translations.original:
That seaside cottage is where
MR. BRINEY lives.

He was once a mighty sailor who never
feared the sea, however stormy.
translations.zh: 海边的小屋是哈奇老人的家。他以前是个了不起的水手，再大的风浪也吓不倒他。

translations.label: Route104_Text_ImNotATrainer
translations.original:
Oh, no, I'm not a TRAINER.

But that's right, if TRAINERS lock eyes,
it's a challenge to battle.

If you don't want to battle, stay out
of their sight.
translations.zh: 不，我不是训练家。不过训练家一旦目光相遇，就代表要对战。要是不想对战，记得避开他们的视线。

translations.label: Route104_Text_OnlyThrowBallAtWildPokemon
translations.original:
You're a thief if you try to steal
someone else's POKéMON.

You should throw POKé BALLS only at
wild POKéMON.
translations.zh: 抢别人宝可梦的就是小偷！精灵球只能对野生宝可梦使用。

translations.label: Route104_Text_ThrowBallAtWeakenedPokemon
translations.original:
If you're going to throw a POKé BALL,
weaken the wild POKéMON first.

It will be easier to catch if it's been
poisoned, burned, or lulled to sleep.
translations.zh: 扔精灵球之前，先削弱野生宝可梦吧。让它中毒、灼伤或者睡着，也能让捕捉更容易。

translations.label: Route104_Text_WhatsItLikeAtBottomOfSea
translations.original:
The sea, huh?

I wonder what it's like at the bottom
of the sea?
translations.zh: 大海啊……海底到底是什么样子的呢？

translations.label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_ManDiggingHisWayToVerdanturf
translations.original:
There's a man digging his way to
VERDANTURF all by his lonesome.
He's desperate to get through.

He says that if he digs little by little
without using machines, he won't
disturb POKéMON, and he'll avoid
harming the natural environment.

I wonder if he made it through yet.
translations.zh: 有个人独自朝绿荫镇的方向挖隧道，急着把道路打通。他说不用机器，一点一点地挖，就不会惊扰宝可梦，也不会破坏自然环境。不知道他挖通了没有。

translations.label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_WeHadToStopBoring
translations.original:
That RUSTURF TUNNEL there…

At first, we had a huge work crew boring
through rock with the latest machinery.
But, we had to stop.

It turns out that we would have had
a negative effect on wild POKéMON in
the area.

So, we've got nothing to do but loll
around here doing nothing.
translations.zh: 那边的卡绿隧道，原本有一大群工人用最新的机器开凿。但后来只能停工了，因为这会影响附近的野生宝可梦。所以我们现在只能闲在这里，无事可做。

translations.label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_DadHelpedClearLandOfTrees
translations.original:
When they were expanding the city of
RUSTBORO, my dad helped out.

He made his POKéMON use CUT to clear
the land of trees.
translations.zh: 扩建卡那兹市时，我爸爸帮过忙。他让宝可梦使用居合斩，砍掉树木来清理土地。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_EveryPokemonHasAbility
translations.original:
Every POKéMON has a special ability
that it can use.
translations.zh: 每只宝可梦都有一种可以使用的特殊能力。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_PokemonStrange
translations.original: POKéMON are such strange creatures.
translations.zh: 宝可梦真是奇妙的生物。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ComingUpWithMealsIsHard
translations.original:
Oh, it's so hard every day…

What's hard?
You need to ask?

It's trying to figure out what to
make for meals every day.

It really isn't easy coming up with
meals every day.
translations.zh: 唉，每天都好难啊……什么事情难？还用问吗？当然是每天都要想该做什么饭啊。天天安排不同的饭菜，真的不容易。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ItsAPokemonPlushDoll
translations.original: It's a POKéMON plush DOLL!
translations.zh: 这是一个宝可梦毛绒玩偶！

translations.label: RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_DevonWorkersLiveHere
translations.original:
DEVON CORPORATION's workers live in
this building.
translations.zh: 这栋楼里住着得文公司的员工。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_DevonWasTinyInOldDays
translations.original:
Way back in the old days, DEVON was just
a teeny, tiny company.
translations.zh: 很久以前，得文还只是一家小得不能再小的公司。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentCollectsRareStones
translations.original:
DEVON's PRESIDENT likes to collect
rare stones.
translations.zh: 得文公司的社长喜欢收集稀有的石头。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentsSonAlsoCollectsRareStones
translations.original:
I think the PRESIDENT's son also
collects rare stones.
translations.zh: 听说社长的儿子也喜欢收集稀有的石头。

translations.label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AllSortsOfPlaces
translations.original:
In all sorts of places, there are all
sorts of POKéMON and people.

I find that fascinating, so I go to all
sorts of places.
translations.zh: 不同的地方有不同的宝可梦，也有不同的人。我觉得很有趣，所以四处旅行。

translations.label: RustboroCity_House2_Text_RoxanneKnowsALot
translations.original:
ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, really knows
a lot about POKéMON.

She's really strong, too!
translations.zh: 道馆馆主杜娟懂得很多宝可梦知识，而且也很强！

translations.label: RustboroCity_House2_Text_TrainerSchoolExcellent
translations.original:
The TRAINER'S SCHOOL is excellent.

If you study there, you could even
become a GYM LEADER.
translations.zh: 训练家学校很不错。在那里好好学习，说不定也能成为道馆馆主。

translations.label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_IGivePerfectlySuitedNicknames
translations.original:
For my own POKéMON, I give them
perfectly suited nicknames!

It's my expression of, uh…
originality, yes, that's it!
translations.zh: 我会给自己的宝可梦起最适合它的昵称！这是我表达……独创性的方式，对，就是独创性！

translations.label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_BuyingHealsInCaseOfShroomish
translations.original:
I'm buying some PARLYZ HEALS and
ANTIDOTES.

Just in case I run into SHROOMISH
in PETALBURG WOODS.
translations.zh: 我要买些解麻药和解毒药，以防在橙华森林遇到蘑蘑菇。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_GettingEscapeRopeJustInCase
translations.original:
I'm getting an ESCAPE ROPE just in
case I get lost in a cave.

I just need to use it to get back to
the entrance.
translations.zh: 我要买一条离洞绳，免得在洞穴里迷路。只要使用它，就能回到洞口。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_ShouldBuySuperPotionsInstead
translations.original:
My POKéMON evolved.
It has a lot of HP now.

I should buy SUPER POTIONS for it
instead of ordinary POTIONS.
translations.zh: 我的宝可梦进化了，体力也增加了。我应该给它买好伤药，而不是普通伤药。

translations.label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HMCutNextDoor
translations.original:
The man next door gave me an HM!

I used it to teach my POKéMON how to
CUT down skinny trees.
translations.zh: 隔壁的叔叔给了我一张秘传学习机！我用它教宝可梦居合斩，可以砍倒细小的树木。

translations.label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MaleAndFemalePokemon
translations.original:
Just like people, there are male and
female POKéMON.

But no one seems to have any idea how
they're different.
translations.zh: 宝可梦和人一样，也有雄性和雌性。不过好像没人说得清它们之间到底有什么差别。

translations.label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonHavePersonalities
translations.original:
My POKéMON has a NAIVE nature, and my
friend's has a JOLLY nature.

It's fascinating how POKéMON have
personalities!
translations.zh: 我的宝可梦是天真性格，朋友的则是爽朗性格。宝可梦竟然还有不同的性格，真有意思！

translations.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_AlwaysWantedSeedot
translations.original:
I always wanted a SEEDOT, and
I'm finally getting one!
translations.zh: 我一直想要一只橡实果，现在终于要得到了！

translations.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ConfusedPokemonAttacksItself
translations.original:
You know how some POKéMON moves can
confuse a POKéMON?

A confused POKéMON will sometimes
attack itself without meaning to.

But once it leaves battle, it will
return to normal.
translations.zh: 有些招式会让宝可梦混乱，你知道吧？混乱的宝可梦有时会不由自主地攻击自己。不过只要离开对战，它就会恢复正常。

translations.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemonHealItselfWithBerry
translations.original:
A POKéMON holding a BERRY will heal
itself…

There are many kinds of items that
POKéMON can hold…

Boy, it sure is hard taking notes
down…
translations.zh: 携带树果的宝可梦会自己恢复……宝可梦可以携带的道具种类好多……唉，做笔记真不容易。

translations.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemontCantUseManMadeItems
translations.original:
POKéMON can hold items, but they
don't know what to do with man-made
items like POTION and ANTIDOTE.
translations.zh: 宝可梦可以携带道具，可是它们不知道怎么使用伤药、解毒药之类的人造道具。

translations.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_TradingRightNow
translations.original:
I'm trading POKéMON with my friend
right now.
translations.zh: 我正在和朋友交换宝可梦。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_CatchRarePokemonIfIGoToSchool
translations.original:
POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL!

If I go to this school, will I be able
to catch rare POKéMON easily?
translations.zh: 宝可梦训练家学校！来这里上学，就能轻松捉到稀有的宝可梦吗？

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_GymLeaderIsntEasyWithFire
translations.original:
I challenged the GYM LEADER, but…

It's not going to be easy winning with
my FIRE-type POKéMON…

FIRE-type POKéMON don't match up
well against ROCK-type POKéMON…
translations.zh: 我挑战了道馆馆主，可是……用我的火属性宝可梦，很难取胜。火属性对岩石属性不太有利……

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_TradePokemonGrowFast
translations.original:
A POKéMON you get in a trade from
someone grows fast.

But if you don't have certain GYM
BADGES, it may not obey you…
translations.zh: 从别人那里交换来的宝可梦成长得很快。不过，没有相应的道馆徽章，它可能不会听你的话……

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_WowYouHavePokemon
translations.original:
Wow, you have POKéMON with you, too.

When I get bigger, I'm going to go
places with POKéMON, too.
translations.zh: 哇，你也带着宝可梦！等我长大了，也要和宝可梦一起去各个地方。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_YouCanHave2On2Battle
translations.original:
Did you know this?

You can have a 2-on-2 battle even
if you're not with another TRAINER.

If you catch the eyes of two TRAINERS
when you have two or more POKéMON,
they'll both challenge you.

Don't you think it'd be cool if you
could beat two TRAINERS by yourself?
translations.zh: 你知道吗？就算身边没有其他训练家，也能进行二对二的双打。队伍里有两只以上的宝可梦，同时被两名训练家看见，他们就会一起挑战你。一个人打败两名训练家，是不是很酷？

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_YoureNewAroundHere
translations.original:
Oh? Who might you be?
You're a new face around these parts.

Have you just transferred into the
POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL?
translations.zh: 哦？你是谁？这一带以前没见过你。你是刚转到宝可梦训练家学校的吗？

translations.label: SlateportCity_Mart_Text_GreatBallIsBetter
translations.original:
A GREAT BALL is better than a POKé BALL
at catching POKéMON.

With this, I should be able to get that
elusive POKéMON…
translations.zh: 超级球比精灵球更容易捉到宝可梦。有了它，应该就能捉到那只难找的宝可梦了……

translations.label: SlateportCity_Mart_Text_SomeItemsOnlyAtMart
translations.original:
The MARKET does have some interesting
merchandise.

But there are some items you can only
get at a POKéMON MART.
translations.zh: 集市上有不少有趣的商品，不过有些道具只能在友好商店买到。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_AquaExistForGoodOfAll
translations.original:
We, TEAM AQUA, exist for the good
of all!
translations.zh: 我们水舰队是为了大家的利益而存在的！

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CanLearnForNefariousDeeds
translations.original:
What I learn here, I can put to use on
nefarious deeds…
translations.zh: 在这里学到的知识，可以用来干坏事……

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_DidntHaveMoney
translations.original:
I didn't have ¥50, so it took a long
time getting by the receptionist.
translations.zh: 我身上没有50块钱，所以花了好长时间，才绕过接待员混进来。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_LearnAboutSeaForBattling
translations.original:
I want to learn about the sea and
use that knowledge for battling.
translations.zh: 我想学习海洋知识，把它用到宝可梦对战中。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_MustBePokemonWeDontKnow
translations.original:
The sea is vast without end, and
infinitely deep…

There must be many POKéMON that
we don't know about.
translations.zh: 大海无边无际，深不可测……一定还有很多我们不了解的宝可梦。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OurBossIsntHere
translations.original:
We were told to assemble here,
so we did, but…

Our BOSS, the linchpin, isn't here.
translations.zh: 有人让我们来这里集合，所以我们就来了，可是……最关键的老大还没到。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
translations.original: Please enjoy yourself.
translations.zh: 请慢慢参观。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RustboroBungled
translations.original:
If our goons didn't bungle things
in RUSTBORO, we wouldn't be here!
translations.zh: 要不是我们的手下在卡那兹市把事情搞砸，也不用跑到这里来！

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_SternIsRoleModel
translations.original:
I get all giddy and gooey when
I see the sea!

For me, CAPT. STERN is the number
one role model!
translations.zh: 一看见大海，我就开心得不得了！对我来说，库斯诺吉船长是最值得学习的榜样！

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WantSeaPokemon
translations.original:
I want a sea POKéMON.

I think it would feel cool and nice
to hug.
translations.zh: 我想要一只海里的宝可梦。抱着它，应该会感觉凉凉的，很舒服。

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WouldStuffHereMakeMeRich
translations.original:
If I ripped off the stuff here,
would it make me rich?
translations.zh: 把这里的东西偷走，我是不是就能发财了？

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_DontRunInMuseum
translations.original:
Don't you dare run around inside
the MUSEUM!
translations.zh: 不许在博物馆里乱跑！

translations.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_RemindsMeOfAbandonedShip
translations.original:
I saw a model of a ship here.

It reminded me of the ABANDONED SHIP
near DEWFORD TOWN…
translations.zh: 我在这里看见了船的模型，让我想起武斗镇附近的弃船……

translations.label: SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RaiseDifferentTypesOfPokemon
translations.original:
Want a tip for battling?

I'd say it's raising different kinds
of POKéMON in a balanced manner.

It's no good to make just one
POKéMON strong.

If it has a type disadvantage,
it might not stand a chance.
translations.zh: 想听个对战建议吗？我觉得应该均衡地培养不同种类的宝可梦，只让一只变强可不行。万一碰上属性不利的对手，它可能一点胜算都没有。

translations.label: SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedMonWithFriend
translations.original:
I trade POKéMON with my friends.

If a traded POKéMON is holding an
item, it makes me twice as happy!
translations.zh: 我会和朋友交换宝可梦。如果换来的宝可梦还带着道具，我就会加倍开心！

translations.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonEnjoyedProtein
translations.original:
Do POKéMON enjoy having items used
on them?

Mine acted really happy when I gave
it some PROTEIN.
translations.zh: 宝可梦喜欢我们给它使用道具吗？我给我的宝可梦用蛋白药时，它看起来特别开心。

translations.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PokemonDontLikeFainting
translations.original:
If you keep letting a POKéMON faint
in battle, it'll come to resent it.

Soon, it will become less trusting
of the TRAINER.

In other words, it certainly won't
like you very much.
translations.zh: 总让宝可梦在对战中倒下，它会因此感到不满，慢慢不再信任训练家。也就是说，它就不会那么喜欢你了。

translations.label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
translations.original:
MR. BRINEY: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
It's been too long!

Aye, since I met you, this old sea dog's
been feeling frisky!

So I've decided to help DOCK make
a ferry.

Aye, after all, a ferry would be able
to carry a lot of people.

But, you know, that DOCK is really
something special.

With his knack for technology and
my experience, I'm sure that we can
build one great ship, aye!
translations.zh: 哈奇老人：啊，{PLAYER}{KUN}！好久不见！自从遇见你，这个老水手又精神起来了！所以我决定帮助造船师建一艘渡轮，毕竟渡轮能载很多人。不过，那位造船师真的很有本事。有他的技术，加上我的经验，我们一定能造出一艘好船！

translations.label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_GetSeasickEasily
translations.original:
I get seasick real easily.
So I get to help out here instead.
translations.zh: 我很容易晕船，所以就留在这里帮忙。

translations.label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_SeaIsLikeLivingThing
translations.original:
The seasons, the weather, where
the moon sits in the sky…

These and other conditions make
the sea change its expression.

That's right!
The sea is like a living thing!
translations.zh: 季节、天气、月亮在天空中的位置……这些条件会让大海展现出不同的表情。没错，大海就像有生命一样！

translations.label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_FloatsBecauseBuoyancy
translations.original:
Don't you think it's strange that
a ship made of heavy iron floats?

It floats because of a principle
called buoyancy.
translations.zh: 你不觉得很奇妙吗？那么重的铁造出来的船，竟然能浮在水面上。它能浮起来，是因为一个叫浮力的原理。

translations.label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_ShipDesignMoreLikeBuilding
translations.original:
Designing a large ship is more like
making a big building than putting
together a transportation vehicle.
translations.zh: 设计一艘大船，感觉更像是在建一栋大楼，而不是制造交通工具。

translations.label: SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentBuiltRecently
translations.original:
Recently, a BATTLE TENT was built
in SLATEPORT.

GYMS are fun, but the BATTLE TENT's
awesome in its own way.

You should go find tough POKéMON
for the BATTLE TENT!
translations.zh: 凯那市最近建了一座对战帐篷。道馆很有趣，不过对战帐篷也有它独特的乐趣。去找些强大的宝可梦，试试对战帐篷吧！

translations.label: SlateportCity_Text_BigSmileForCamera
translations.original:
TY: Okay, CAPT. STERN, a big smile
for the camera!
translations.zh: 摄影师：好了，库斯诺吉船长，对着镜头笑一个！

translations.label: SlateportCity_Text_BuyTooMuch
translations.original:
Whenever I visit here, I get carried
away and buy too much.
translations.zh: 每次来这里，我都会兴奋得买太多东西。

translations.label: SlateportCity_Text_CantChangeTradeMonName
translations.original:
Any POKéMON you get in a trade,
you can't change its nickname.

The original TRAINER's love for that
POKéMON is in the nickname.
translations.zh: 从别人那里交换来的宝可梦，你不能更改它的昵称。那个名字里包含着原训练家对它的爱。

translations.label: SlateportCity_Text_MostInvaluableExperience
translations.original:
GABBY: I see, I see. You've had a most
invaluable experience…
translations.zh: 采访员：原来如此，原来如此。你有过一段非常宝贵的经历啊……

translations.label: SlateportCity_Text_SeaIsSoWet
translations.original:
The sea is just so vast…

Could the sea have been made by
the tears shed by POKéMON?
translations.zh: 大海真是辽阔啊……这片大海会不会是宝可梦流下的泪水形成的呢？

translations.label: SlateportCity_Text_ShouldveBroughtMyGameBoy
translations.original:
Grumble…

I should've brought my Game Boy
Advance so I wouldn't get bored in line…

Grumble…
translations.zh: 哼……排队真无聊，早知道该把Game Boy Advance带来了……哼……

translations.label: SlateportCity_Text_SinkOldBoats
translations.original:
Do you know what they do with old
ships that become too creaky to sail?

They sink them in the sea so they
become habitats for POKéMON.
translations.zh: 你知道老旧到不能航行的船会怎样处理吗？人们会把它们沉到海里，让它们成为宝可梦的栖息地。

translations.label: SlateportCity_Text_WonderIfLighthouseStartlesPokemon
translations.original:
The light of the lighthouse reaches
dozens of miles away.

I wonder if it doesn't startle POKéMON
in the sea.
translations.zh: 灯塔的光能照到几十英里之外。不知道会不会把海里的宝可梦吓一跳。
